required_metrics.name: mdemg_http_requests_total
required_metrics.description: Total HTTP requests counter must be present

required_metrics.name: mdemg_circuit_breaker_state
required_metrics.description: Circuit breaker state gauge must be present

required_metrics.name: mdemg_cache_hit_ratio
required_metrics.description: Cache hit ratio gauge must be present

required_metrics.name: mdemg_http_request_duration_seconds
required_metrics.description: HTTP request duration histogram must be present

required_metrics.name: mdemg_retrieval_latency_seconds
required_metrics.description: Retrieval latency histogram must be present
